controls: Candidate family names select types; verify actual weapon dispatch on the reference.
Audit initial visibility, diplomacy, cash, tech, day clock, HP, regeneration and passive AI.
Issue one attack at tick 12; suppress further launches without cancelling the first flight.
Move target or kill source at tick 13 in the corresponding variants; record actual launch ordering.
Verify clear paths and matched endpoints; terrain interception requires an audited terrain/height fixture.
Sweep splash offsets separately per victim type and side; refine observed transitions at radius minus one, radius and radius plus one pixel.
Repeat after swapping sides and at diagonal offsets; classify overlapping category flags from audited metadata.
Capture every flight position and ground/render height, every impact and every damage event through tick 720.
Burn completion needs an audited status removal event and a damage-free tail after a single shot; building fire animation is insufficient.
Record and replay twice from identical pristine game copies before comparing the clone.
